notes: Canvas: adjustment layers. Curves, levels, hue / saturation, colour balance, black & white, gradient map and brightness / contrast change what is under them without touching it (the half-circle button under the layer list)
Develop: a photo's exposure, highlights, shadows, warmth, clarity, sharpening, noise, vignette and grain in one panel, with Auto
An adjustment can be clipped to one layer, faded, masked with the brush or eraser, changed at any time, or merged down to keep it
Lithophane: Light and detail fixes a dim or flat photo before it becomes a print, with Auto
